title: approve the outline
oneLiner: You approve the direction, while it is cheap to change.
gate: the direction and the running order are right
summary: The owner reads one page and approves what the video IS and what order it happens in - or reorders, renames, or cuts sections. The last cheap moment to change direction. Once approved the section names are locked, because the script plan's `### SECTION:` headings and the intro roadmap must match them word for word.
